title: Restore real-world 2D drafting foundation from CAD-BENCH-RW-001
objective: Restore a trustworthy 2D drafting foundation on current mainline, beginning with canonical document/layer/selection state integrity exposed by the CAD-BENCH-RW-001 production black-box benchmark, without changing frozen Architecture v1.1 or Construction Graph authority.
acceptance_criteria: UI-created and command-created layers resolve to one canonical document layer table and active-layer changes cause newly created entities to use the selected canonical layer.
NEW fully resets document/editor state, including active-layer references, selection, transient command state, view state and entity-count state, with no dangling references or phantom entities.
Command selection, canvas picking and Properties selection share one canonical selection state and screen-space picking uses a deterministic declared tolerance.
Successful command feedback is emitted only after the canonical transaction commits; failed operations expose explicit typed failure without a preceding false success claim.

The golden browser workflows G1, G2, G3, G5, G7, G8, G9 and G10 from CAD-BENCH-RW-001 have reproducible before/after evidence showing the targeted foundation defects are resolved or honestly typed where outside this slice.
Deterministic automated tests cover layer identity/activation, NEW reset, selection synchronization, screen-space picking tolerance, entity-count integrity and authoritative command feedback.
Web and Electron preserve the same affected semantic behavior through the shared App API and existing engine/adapter boundaries remain unchanged.
Existing verified CAD/BIM regression baselines remain green and the change introduces no architecture drift or protected-path modification without an ACR.
non_goals: No HATCH feature implementation in this slice.
No new BIM authoring scope beyond what is unlocked by the repaired selection foundation.
No architecture modification; Architecture v1.1 remains frozen.
No self-approval or self-verification by the implementation agent.
risk_assumptions: CAD-BENCH-RW-001 is the current black-box observation of main and its findings supersede historical assumptions that COMPAT-CAD-001 behavior remains present.
Historical COMPAT-CAD-001 Issue #37 / PR #38 is not reused as current-state evidence because mainline behavior has diverged since that merge.
The layer/selection failures appear to share canonical-identity/state synchronization roots; implementation must prove this rather than patch individual UI symptoms.
Viewport clipping, zoom/pan and ARRAY materialization are deliberately deferred until the first state/selection slice is stable.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic tests for canonical layer identity, active-layer behavior, NEW reset and entity-count integrity.
Deterministic tests and real-browser evidence for unified selection state and screen-space object picking.
Tests proving failed canonical transactions do not emit false success feedback.
Web/Electron parity evidence for affected semantics.
Exact-head CI evidence with existing CAD/BIM regressions remaining green.
Production or exact preview browser evidence rerunning the targeted CAD-BENCH-RW-001 golden workflows.
Evidence that Architecture v1.1, Construction Graph authority and engine/worker boundaries remain intact.

transitions.reason: CAD-BENCH-RW-001 production benchmark identified systemic drafting foundation failures; the remediation scope is bounded to current requirement CAD-001 and frozen Architecture v1.1.
Architect release directive: z-ai-implementation-agent is authorized to implement COMPAT-CAD-005 from verified mainline and must stop at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING.

Begin the first foundation slice from main 311815f: layer identity unification via authoritative snapshot adoption, NEW full editor reset, unified/pruned selection state, declared screen-space pick tolerance with a stable viewport, and commit-authoritative command echo.
